logic_group.name: ndpi category loader
logic_group.description: The nDPI category loader is responsible for parsing custom category configuration files and populating the library's internal classification structures. It supports TAB-separated files where each line maps a hostname or an IP address (including CIDR notation for both IPv4 and IPv6) to a numeric category ID. The implementation handles line-by-line parsing, skips comments, and dispatches entries to specialized loaders: IP addresses are stored in Patricia trees for efficient longest-prefix matching, while hostnames are added to a domain classification hash table. This allows nDPI to extend its built-in protocol detection with user-defined categories for specific network entities.
